description: Descriptor of every admitted native GNI student file (75 in the training pool, 4 held out: GNI projects 7 and 8), as consumed by code/corpus/similarity.py score(): element_type_histogram, storey_count, footprint_m2, footprint_aspect, n_products (plus the metric placement box). S_struct between any two records = 0.6 * cosine(type histograms over the union vocabulary) + 0.4 * mean of the defined symmetric ratios min/max of (storey_count+1), footprint_m2, footprint_aspect, n_products. pairwise_S_struct is the matrix over the 79 files in the order of "files".
